versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Instagram location content scraping skill.
- Supports scraping public Instagram posts tagged at specific locations using Apify's apidojo/instagram-location-scraper.
- Returns details for each post: URL, caption, author handle, likes, comments, and timestamp.
- Includes guidance on finding Instagram location IDs and filtering/extracting top posts or creators.
- Designed for hospitality, event marketing, and content curation use cases.
- Output includes reports of engagement, top content, top creators, and common caption themes.
